antiraid.description_commande: Protects the server from suspicious waves of joins (raids)
antiraid.opt_age: Minimum account age, in days (0 to require nothing)
antiraid.sous_verrouiller: Locks the server down right away, as if a raid were happening
antiraid.active_age_actif: Accounts younger than {duree} will be removed on arrival.
antiraid.note_config: These thresholds are changed in config.js.
antiraid.raid_active: Anti-raid mode **enabled**. The server is locked down.

automod.sous_module: Enables or disables a specific module
automod.grp_mots_ajouter: Adds a word to the forbidden list
automod.grp_mots_retirer: Removes a word from the forbidden list
automod.grp_exemption: Channels and roles exempt from automatic moderation
automod.grp_exemption_ajouter: Exempts a channel or a role
automod.opt_retirer_salon: Channel to remove from the exemptions
automod.opt_retirer_role: Role to remove from the exemptions
automod.mot_ajoute: **{mot}** added to the forbidden word list.
automod.mot_retire: **{mot}** removed from the forbidden word list.
automod.exemptions_note: Messages from these channels or roles are never filtered.
automod.exemption_cible_manquante: Give a channel or a role.
automod.etat_seuil_repetitions: Repeats: **{n}** identical messages in a row
automod.etat_seuil_mentions: Mentions: **{n}** mentions in a single message
automod.etat_sanction_valeur: **{n}** warnings within **{minutes}** minutes trigger a **{mute}**-minute timeout

boost.description_commande: What the server offers to its boosters
boost.sous_role: Extra role given for each boost
boost.sous_liste: List of the members boosting the server
boost.salon_vide: Boosts will no longer be announced.
boost.role_impossible: I can't grant {role}: it's too high, or managed by an integration.
boost.role_defini: {role} will be given on every boost.
boost.role_vide: No extra role will be given.
boost.recompense_sans_economie: Reward set to **{montant}**, but the economy is disabled: it won't be paid out.
boost.recompense_definie: **{montant} {monnaie}** will be given for each boost.
boost.liste_vide: Nobody is boosting this server right now.

demarrer.description_commande: Guided setup assistant, to get started in a few clicks
demarrer.suite_valeur:
`/config` opens the full settings panel, setting by setting.
`/aide` lists every command.
demarrer.permissions_valeur:
**{liste}**
Features that depend on them won't work until the bot's role has them.
demarrer.permission_requise: You need the Manage Server permission to use this assistant.

bienvenue.explication: Where the bot announces new members arriving. Pick a channel, or skip this step to announce nothing.

logs.explication: Where the bot writes sanctions, kicks and bans. Pick a channel only staff can see.

xp.explication: Members earn XP by chatting and level up. Enabled by default — it's often why a bot like this gets added.

economie.explication: A virtual currency, daily rewards, a shop. You'll be able to fine-tune everything later with `/config`.

automod.explication: Filters spam, invites, links and mass mentions automatically. Fine-tune it with `/automod`.

serveur.sous_activer: Enables verification and sets the access role
serveur.opt_captcha: Ask a small math question (default: no)
serveur.opt_categorie: Category to create the channel in
serveur.sous_lier: Turns an existing channel into a counter
serveur.sous_retirer: Stops tracking a channel (without deleting it)
serveur.sous_liste: Shows the stat channels and the available variables
serveur.verif_role_impossible: I won't be able to grant {role}: it's too high, or managed by an integration.
serveur.verif_activee: Verification **enabled**. Members will receive {role} once validated.
serveur.verif_captcha_actif: They'll be asked a small math question.
serveur.verif_captcha_inactif: A single click will be enough.
serveur.verif_a_faire:
**Next step**: remove the permission to view channels from `@everyone`, and grant it to the role above. Keep only the verification channel visible to everyone.
Then post the panel with `/server verification panel`.
serveur.verif_pas_prete: Enable verification first with `/server verification enable`.
serveur.verif_aucune_option: Fill in at least one option.
serveur.verif_texte_maj: Panel updated. Republish it to see the result.
serveur.verif_etat_pied: Post the panel with `/server verification panel`
serveur.stats_aucun: No stat channel yet. Create one with `/server stats create`.
serveur.stats_savoir_valeur:
Updated every **{minutes} minutes** — Discord limits channel renames to 2 per 10-minute window.
`{enligne}` needs the *Presence* intent in the Developer Portal, or it will show 0.
serveur.stats_rien_a_faire: Nothing to change, or Discord's rename limit has been reached.
serveur.stats_retire: {salon} is no longer updated automatically. The channel itself wasn't deleted.
serveur.stats_cree:
Channel created: **{nom}**
Nobody can connect to it, it's for display only.
Updated every {minutes} minutes.

structure.description_commande: Snapshots the server's roles, channels and permissions, and restores them
structure.sous_photo: Takes a snapshot of the current structure
structure.sous_comparer: What changed since a snapshot (changes nothing)
structure.sous_reparer: Restores what changed — never deletes anything
structure.sous_exporter: Sends a snapshot as a JSON file, in a DM
structure.sous_auto: Automatic daily snapshot, and how many to keep
structure.opt_garder: How many snapshots to keep (1 to 50)
structure.comp_diff: **{n} difference(s)** between the {date} snapshot and the server now.
structure.comp_identique: The server is **identical** to the {date} snapshot. Nothing to repair.
structure.ajouts_valeur:
{roles} role(s), {salons} channel(s).
*A repair won't delete them: I never delete anything.*
structure.comp_pied: {roles} roles and {salons} channels in the snapshot
structure.photo_prise:
Snapshot **#{n}** saved: **{roles} roles**, **{salons} channels** and their permissions.
-# `/structure compare` to see what changed, `/structure repair photo:{n}` to restore it.
structure.liste_vide: No snapshot yet. `/structure photo` takes one.
structure.liste_pied: A repair never deletes anything: it recreates and restores.
structure.auto_fait:
Automatic snapshot: **{actif}**.
Snapshots kept: **{max}** (the oldest are erased).
structure.introuvable_numero: No snapshot **#{n}** on this server. `/structure list` shows the ones that exist.
structure.introuvable_aucune: No snapshot saved. `/structure photo` takes one.
structure.export_impossible: Can't send you a DM: open your DMs and try again.
structure.reparer_deja_identique: The server is already identical to snapshot **#{n}**. There is nothing to repair.
structure.reparer_intro:
I'm going to **recreate what's missing** and **restore what changed**.
**I won't delete anything** — no channel, no role, no message.
structure.reparer_en_cours: Repairing… I'm going slowly to avoid getting rate-limited by Discord.
structure.resume_rien: Nothing could be done — check the errors below.
structure.resume_pied_photo: A snapshot #{n} was taken right before, just in case.
structure.resume_pied_vide: A recreated channel is empty: its old messages can't be recovered.

veille.description_commande: Automatically announces new Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, TikTok or RSS posts
veille.sous_ajouter: Watches an account or a feed
veille.opt_source: Twitch handle, YouTube channel (@handle or UC...), or feed address. Not needed for Instagram.
veille.sous_tester: Checks a source right now and announces its latest post
veille.sous_jeton: Instagram token status, and immediate renewal
veille.ajouter_source_manquante_youtube: Give the channel in the `source` option: `@yourhandle`, its address, or its ID starting with `UC`.
veille.ajouter_source_manquante_generique: Give the feed address in the `source` option.
veille.ajouter_rss_invalide: The feed address must start with http:// or https://
veille.ajouter_plafond:
This server is already watching **{deja}** sources, that is the maximum.
Remove one with `/watch remove` to add another.
veille.ajouter_guide_instagram: Follow the steps in **GUIDE-INSTAGRAM.txt** to get a token.
veille.ajouter_guide_twitch: Follow the steps in **GUIDE-TWITCH.txt** to create the Twitch application.
veille.etat_twitch_direct: **{nom}** is live right now — that stream won't be announced, the bot starts from now.
veille.etat_twitch_hors_ligne: **{nom}** is offline: the next stream will be announced.
veille.etat_derniere_pub: Latest post spotted: **{titre}** — it won't be announced, the bot starts from now.
veille.ajoutee_titre: Source added (**#{n}**). Announcements will go to {salon}
veille.liste_vide: No source being watched. Add one with `/watch add`.
veille.jeton_absent:
No Instagram token saved.
Add `INSTAGRAM_TOKEN=...` to the `.env` file then restart the bot. The steps are in **GUIDE-INSTAGRAM.txt**.
veille.jeton_renouvele:
Token renewed. It's valid for **60 days**, until {date}.
The bot renews it automatically every 40 days, you shouldn't ever need to touch it again.
veille.jeton_echec:
Renewal failed:
```{raison}```
If the token is more than 60 days old, you'll need to generate a new one (see GUIDE-INSTAGRAM.txt).
veille.test_rien: Source readable, but nothing new to announce.
